definition: Filling missing or masked regions of an image with plausible content.
details: Filling missing or masked regions of an image with plausible content. GAN and diffusion approaches enable object removal and restoration.

explainer.lead: Image inpainting fills missing or masked regions of an image with plausible content. It enables object removal and restoration.

tiers.eli5: Like patching a hole in a wall so smoothly that you cannot tell where the hole was.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers mask the unwanted region and let a generative model fill it; a common pitfall is content that looks plausible locally but is inconsistent with the rest of the image.
tiers.paperLevel: Filling missing or masked regions of an image with plausible content; GAN and diffusion approaches enable object removal and restoration.

explainer.example: Removing an object from a photo by masking it and filling the masked region with plausible content.
